# Does your values.yaml actually match its own schema?

> Paste a Helm values.yaml and values.schema.json to find silently ignored typos, missing required fields and type mismatches. Runs in your browser, no Helm needed.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
